test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is INCORRECT?

options.text: The Planning Commission of India was set up in 1950.
Distinguished economists from India and abroad were invited to advise on India’s economic development during the first five-year plan period.
India borrowed the idea of five-year plans from the former Soviet Union.
The chairmanship of the Planning Commission of India was given to the Prime Minister.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Distinguished economists from India and abroad were invited to advise on India's economic development during the first five-year plan period**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 2** is incorrect because, during the first five-year plan period, distinguished economists from India and abroad were not specifically invited to advise on India's economic development.
